name: 4-HO-McPeT
summary: 4-HO-McPeT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-methyl-N-cyclopentyltryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative related to known psychedelic tryptamines like psilocin (4-HO-DMT). It was described in the scientific literature by David Repke and colleagues in 1981.
summaryZh: 4-HO-McPeT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C16H22N2O，具有血清素的作用，發現於1981年。

uses.en: It is known only from the scientific literature as a research compound.
uses.zh: 它只以研究用化合物的身分出現在科學文獻中。
uses.zhHans: 它只以研究用化合物的身分出现在科学文献中。

fact.en: One of the groups on its nitrogen is a cyclopentyl ring, five carbon atoms joined in a loop. David Repke and colleagues described it in 1981 during work on psilocin-like compounds.
fact.zh: 它氮原子上的其中一個基團是環戊基，也就是五個碳原子連成的環。David Repke與同事在1981年研究類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素的化合物時描述了它。
fact.zhHans: 它氮原子上的其中一个基团是环戊基，也就是五个碳原子连成的环。David Repke与同事在1981年研究类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素的化合物时描述了它。
